description: Pollable stream of fresh Robinhood Chain calls by X accounts with a MEASURED early-call record (default since caller-rules-2: rank_score >= 0.3, the 95% Wilson lower bound on the early rate = grade B, on >= 4 graded calls, coordinated clusters excluded). Each item carries the caller's full measured record (rank_score and evidence included) + the token's deployer score and FDV. A measured record describes past calls, not future ones. Costs $0.02 USDC on Base. (paid $0.02, or included in a RobinX plan key — see instructions)

min_early_rate.description: optional extra floor on the raw early rate; no default

min_rank_score.description: floor on rank_score (the 95% Wilson lower bound on the early rate); default 0.3 = grade B

since.description: captured_at cursor from a prior call

name: robinx_signals
title: Fresh calls by measured early-callers
